name: Fox Corporation
description: Fox owns the FOX broadcast network, 29 local TV stations, the FOX News Media, FOX Business, FS1 and Big Ten Network cable channels, the free ad-supported streaming service Tubi, and the FOX One subscription streamer. It earns money from two sources: fees that cable, satellite and streaming TV distributors and local-station affiliates pay to carry its channels (distribution) and advertising, which is strong around news and live sports. The cable segment is 43 percent of revenue and 79 percent of segment profit; television (network, stations, Tubi) is 56 percent of revenue, with profit up 52 percent in fiscal 2026. On 2026-06-14 Fox agreed to acquire Roku for $96.00 cash plus 0.9693 Fox Class A shares per Roku share, subject to approvals.
